notes: Study streaks: your daily study streak now shows on the Study tab and is saved on this device.
Session stats: a 'Your progress' row tracks packs generated, cards reviewed, quizzes taken, and average quiz score.
Weak-area review: the Cards tab lists the terms you mark 'Again' most with a one-tap drill; the Quiz tab shows per-type accuracy and a 'Retry missed' round for only the questions you missed.
Quiz variety: new true/false and put-in-order sequencing questions mixed in with the existing types.
Smoother Generate flow: spinner + progress text while your study pack builds, and empty states that point you back to the Study tab.
Update reliability: the version shown always comes from the running app, and the update notice can no longer claim 'latest' while stuck on an old build.
Installable as a phone app: open the site in Safari, Share > Add to Home Screen — new app icon, fullscreen app mode, theme color.
